verdict.rationale: Qodo's core product generates AI insights and suggestions from the user's own code and PR data. It produces severity-ranked findings that explain what, why and how to fix, with one-click fixes, structured PR summaries, risk/blast-radius classification, relevance scoring learned from team PR history, Rule Miner rules mined from past PRs, and in-PR chat. A community comment corroborates that it assigns ticket-compliance levels. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and in-depth docs on portal-level codebase-health insights (only thin governance/history mentions).
